subject: Demo window consolidation — overlapping stakeholder sessions
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@lumenpay.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Demo window request — LumenPay stakeholders overlapping

Hi Nikhil / Ben,

Thanks again for the time tomorrow. Quick update on our end: several of our engineering stakeholders (including our VP Eng) have back-to-back review sessions and can only join a 30–40 minute block between 11:00–11:45 PT. There are also two parallel product-review syncs the prospect team is running the same day, so attendee availability is spotty.

Is it possible to consolidate the demo so we cover the priority flows in ~30 minutes and follow up with a short technical Q&A recording or a separate deep-dive for the infra folks? If we do 30 minutes, we want the first half to be the product surface (high level) and the latter to touch on integration/ops.

We appreciate flexibility — Elena (me) and Samir (engineering) will both attend that 11:00–11:45 PT window if you can make it.

Attachments: calendar-overlap-screenshot.png

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director of Product Operations
LumenPay

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@lumenpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo window request — LumenPay stakeholders overlapping

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the screenshot. We can absolutely consolidate to a short, focused run; appreciate the guidance on priorities.

A few quick notes from our side before we lock time:
- Soojin (our SE) is traveling and will be in transit on the morning of the 9th; they can be on for the first ~20 minutes live from a mobile connection but would prefer to run the deep technical section later the same day or via a recorded Q&A.
- We can offer two options:
  1) 11:00–11:40 PT on Tue 2/9 — 25 minutes product + 15 minutes quick technical QA (Soojin will join first 20 minutes live).
  2) 11:30–12:00 PT on Tue 2/9 — product-focused 30 minutes with a follow-up 45-minute technical slot later that afternoon for infra.

Can you confirm which option fits better for the stakeholders (priority order: product flows first, integration/ops second)? If you'd prefer, we can also send a 6–8 minute pre-recorded snippet for the infra team to watch ahead of time and triage questions during the short live slot.

I've attached a short doc that lists suggested talking points so we hit the right items in a compressed session.

Attachments: prospect-priorities.docx

Thanks — I can make either option work.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@lumenpay.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo window request — LumenPay stakeholders overlapping

On Mon, Feb 8, 2027 at 10:08 AM Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com> wrote:
> Can you confirm which option fits better for the stakeholders (priority order: product flows first, integration/ops second)?

Quick note from me — I'm on travel with intermittent wifi. I can join live for the first ~20 minutes of the 11:00–11:40 PT slot and walk the integration overview at a high level. For the deeper operational questions (KV cache, routing policies, observability), I'd like to do a follow-up 30–45 minute technical session later in the day (I have an open slot 3:00–4:00 PT) or we can do an async recording beforehand.

If you lock the 11:00 start, I'll prioritize the live join and queue the deep-dive for 3:00–3:45 PT unless you prefer a different follow-up time.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference (travelling)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@lumenpay.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@lumenpay.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 14:23:00 -0800
Subject: Confirming 11:00–11:40 PT + 3:00–3:45 PT follow-up (LumenPay)

Elena / Samir — great, thanks for the quick replies. Based on availability, we'll run with option 1:

- Live demo: Tue, Feb 9 — 11:00–11:40 PT (25/15 split; product first, short technical Q&A)
- SE deep-dive: Tue, Feb 9 — 3:00–3:45 PT (technical, ops-focused) — Soojin confirmed availability for this slot.

Agenda (short):
- 11:00–11:25 PT: product flows, customer-facing UX, routing examples (Nikhil)
- 11:25–11:40 PT: quick technical Q&A (Soojin live for first 20)
- 15:00–15:45 PT: technical deep-dive (Soojin) — KV cache behavior, batching/latency tradeoffs, security controls.

I've updated the calendar invites and attached a screenshot of the updated event blocks. If anything changes on your side, reply here and we can pivot. HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
